name: Permission (Venue / Room)
description: Official request to the HoD or another authority for permission to conduct an event or use a venue such as a seminar hall or classroom

fields.label: Submitted to
fields.question: Who is this letter submitted to? (for example: HoD (CSE Dept.))

fields.label: Event name
fields.question: What is the name of the event?

fields.label: Venue
fields.question: Which venue do you need? (for example: Seminar Hall 402, CSE Department)

fields.label: Event date
fields.question: On which date is the event?

fields.label: Start time
fields.question: What time does the event start? (for example: 06:00 PM)

fields.label: End time
fields.question: What time does the event end?

fields.label: Brief description
fields.question: Give a short description of the event, or use the AI draft button.

fields.label: Objective
fields.question: What is the objective of the event?

fields.label: Number of participants
fields.question: How many participants are expected? (for example: 150+)

fields.label: Mode
fields.question: Will the event be Offline, Online or Hybrid?

fields.label: Event organizers
fields.question: Who are the event organisers? (for example: ACM Core 2026-27)

fields.label: Tech assistant: name
fields.question: What is the name of the tech assistant of the venue?

fields.label: Tech assistant: designation
fields.question: What is the tech assistant's designation? (for example: Tech Assistant, Seminar Hall)

fields.label: Faculty in-charge: name
fields.question: What is the name of the faculty in-charge of the venue?

fields.label: Faculty in-charge: designation
fields.question: What is the faculty in-charge's designation? (for example: Faculty in-charge, Seminar Hall)

name: Prize Money Receipt
description: Receipt signed by a competition winner acknowledging prize money, with the winner's bank account details, recommended for payment by the chairman

fields.label: Event / competition name
fields.question: What is the name of the competition or event?

fields.label: Event date
fields.question: On which date was the event held?

fields.label: Venue
fields.question: Where was the event held?

fields.label: Winner's name
fields.question: What is the winner's name?

fields.label: Roll no.
fields.question: What is the winner's roll number?

fields.label: Course & semester
fields.question: Which course and semester is the winner in? (for example: B.Tech CSE, Sem 5)

fields.label: Mobile no.
fields.question: What is the winner's mobile number?

fields.label: Position
fields.question: Which position did the winner secure? (for example: 1st, 2nd, 3rd)

fields.label: Prize amount (Rs.)
fields.question: What is the prize amount in rupees?

fields.label: Name as per bank account
fields.question: What is the name as per the bank account?

fields.label: Bank name
fields.question: Which bank is the account in?

fields.label: Branch
fields.question: Which branch is the account in?

fields.label: Account no.
fields.question: What is the bank account number?

fields.label: IFSC code
fields.question: What is the IFSC code?

fields.label: PAN card no.
fields.question: What is the PAN card number?

name: Submitted (Approval Note to Dean)
description: Approval note submitted to the Dean (Students Welfare) asking permission to conduct an event, with its category, objectives, audience, judges and a financial proposal with expenses

fields.label: Event code
fields.question: What short code should the reference number use for this event? (for example: SIH)

fields.label: Title of the event
fields.question: What is the title of the event? (for example: Internal Hackathon of SIH)

fields.label: Schedule of event (date)
fields.question: On which date is the event?

fields.label: Event venue
fields.question: Where will the event be held?

fields.label: Category of the event
fields.question: What category is the event? (for example: Hackathon, Workshop, Contest)

fields.label: Brief description
fields.question: Give a short description of the event, or use the AI draft button.

fields.label: Objectives
fields.question: What are the objectives of the event?

fields.label: Target audience
fields.question: Who is the event for? (for example: All year students)

fields.label: Expected number of participants
fields.question: How many participants are expected? (for example: 1000+)

fields.label: Name of judges
fields.question: Who are the judges, if there are any?

fields.label: Financial proposal (expenses)
fields.question: What are the expenses? List each item with its approximate amount.

name: Bill Summary
description: Summary of the payments to be made for an event: prize money and other reimbursements with account details, a grand total and the officials' signatures

fields.label: Event name
fields.question: For which event is this bill summary? (for example: SIH Internal Hackathon)

fields.label: Prize money payees
fields.question: Who gets prize money, and how much? Leave empty if there is none.

fields.label: Other payees (reimbursements)
fields.question: Who else should be paid (reimbursements)? Give name, bank details and amount.

name: Bill Certificate (Form BC-R)
description: Bill certificate for recurring expenditure (Form BC-R): certifies purchased items, supplier and payment details for an approved event and is sent for bill payment

fields.label: Approval note no.
fields.question: Which approval note is this bill for? Pick it from the list or type its number (for example: ACM/2026-27/SIH/001)

fields.label: Approval note date
fields.question: What is the date of the approval note? (filled automatically when the note was made here)

fields.label: Purchase order no. and date
fields.question: Purchase order number and date, if any (leave empty for NiL)

fields.label: Advance drawn (Rs.)
fields.question: Advance drawn in rupees, if any (leave empty for NiL)

fields.label: Name of the person certifying the goods
fields.question: Who certifies the goods (the 'I, am ...' line)? Leave empty to write the name by hand.

fields.label: Items purchased
fields.question: What was purchased? List each item with its quantity and unit cost.

fields.label: Taxes or other charges (Rs.)
fields.question: Taxes or other charges in rupees, if any

fields.label: Name of the supplier
fields.question: What is the name of the supplier?

fields.label: GST no.
fields.question: What is the supplier's GST number, if any?

fields.label: Any other taxes
fields.question: Any other taxes? (leave empty for a dash)

fields.label: Invoice no.
fields.question: What is the invoice number?

fields.label: Invoice date
fields.question: What is the invoice date?

fields.label: Invoice amount (Rs.)
fields.question: Invoice amount, only if it differs from the total including taxes

fields.label: Name of the party
fields.question: Who is to be paid (name of the party)?

fields.label: Account number
fields.question: What is the party's account number?

fields.label: Account holder name
fields.question: What is the account holder's name?

fields.label: Name of the bank
fields.question: Which bank is the account in?

fields.label: Name of the branch
fields.question: Which branch is the account in?

fields.label: IFSC code
fields.question: What is the IFSC code?

fields.label: Faculty designation
fields.question: Designation of the faculty chairman (leave empty for Assistant Professor)

fields.label: Laboratory / office
fields.question: Laboratory or office for the stock entry (leave empty for Student Council)

name: Invitation Notice
description: Notice or invitation announcing an event to students

name: Budget Request
description: Request for funds listing expected expenses for an event
